name: Tii-kun no Ecchi na Hanayome Shugyou ♡
original_name: ティーくんのえっちな花嫁修行♡
source:
In the year 20XX, the government decided to protect the Neighboring Tribes—particularly the beastmen—whose numbers had been declining year by year.
One day, the “Beastman Bride Act” was enacted, a law that pairs eligible single men with beastman brides.
Waiting for me when I came home exhausted from work was Tii, a cat-like beastman bride♂.
I decided to live with Tii for the 10-day aptitude test period, and so our life together began.
translation:
20XX年，政府决定保护数量逐年减少的邻近部落，尤其是兽人。
有一天，《兽人新娘法》颁布，这是一项将符合条件的单身男性与兽人新娘配对的法律。
当我下班疲惫地回到家时，等待我的是像猫一样的兽人新娘♂蒂。
我决定和Tii一起度过10天的能力测试期，我们的共同生活就这样开始了。
